entities.name: Duskmourn Rescue Mission
entities.description: A 4564 AR expedition into Duskmourn to rescue Nashi from Valgavoth and his cult.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: Nightmare-realm plane ruled by the demon Valgavoth.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Person who disappeared and was rescued from Duskmourn; resolved to carry on Tamiyo's storytelling legacy.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Demon who took over Duskmourn and empowers himself with stories siphoned from Tamiyo's echo.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: Cult serving the demon Valgavoth in Duskmourn.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who organized the rescue of Nashi.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Planeswalker from Kaldheim recruited by Kaito; reached the cult's chamber with Zimone.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: Planeswalker brought along by Tyvar; rescued Nashi with the Wanderer.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: Specialist assembled by Niv-Mizzet who entered Duskmourn.

entities.name: Aminatou
entities.description: Specialist who refused to enter Duskmourn but gave the team fateshifter tokens and aided the artificial Omenpath.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: Being who told Kaito Nashi had disappeared and who entered Duskmourn with the group.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon on Ravnica who assembled additional specialists for the mission.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: Figure who helped rescue Nashi from wickerfolk before betraying the group to the cult to fulfill his bargain.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who entered Duskmourn with Vraska in search of Loot and fought a nightmare with Kaito.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who entered Duskmourn with Jace.

entities.name: Marina Vendrell
entities.description: Person whose role in Valgavoth's takeover of Duskmourn Tyvar and Zimone uncovered.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Deceased planeswalker whose body yielded a scroll and whose echo the cult siphoned stories from.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Created an artificial Omenpath to return Kaito to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Plane where Tyvar was recruited.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane reached by Omenpath; where Niv-Mizzet assembled specialists.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane Tyvar visited with Zimone afterward.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion over a year before the mission.

events.summary: Kaito stole back a scroll from Tamiyo's body and learned from the Wanderer that Nashi had disappeared.
events.quote: Kaito Shizuki stole back a scroll recovered from Tamiyo 's body

events.summary: Kaito recruited Tyvar on Kaldheim, who insisted on bringing Niko.
events.quote: Kaito recruited Tyvar Kell on Kaldheim

events.summary: The group went to Ravnica via Omenpath, where Niv-Mizzet had assembled Zimone and Aminatou; Aminatou refused to enter Duskmourn but gave fateshifter tokens.
events.quote: While Aminatou refused to enter Duskmourn

events.summary: Kaito, Tyvar, Niko, Zimone and the Wanderer entered the door to Duskmourn.
events.quote: Kaito, Tyvar, Niko, Zimone, and the Wanderer entered the door to Duskmourn.

events.summary: Inside, the group was quickly separated.
events.quote: Inside, the group was quickly separated.

events.summary: Niko and the Wanderer rescued Nashi from wickerfolk with Winter's help, but Winter betrayed them to the cult.
events.quote: before betraying them to the Cult of Valgavoth to fulfill his bargain with the demon

events.summary: Kaito met Jace, fought off a fear-born nightmare, then split after a falling-out and returned to Ravnica.
events.quote: The two fought off a fear-born nightmare but later split after a falling-out

events.summary: Tyvar and Zimone reunited with and freed Nashi, Niko and the Wanderer, and learned the cult siphoned Tamiyo's stories to empower Valgavoth.
events.quote: Tyvar and Zimone reunited with and freed Nashi, Niko, and the Wanderer.

events.summary: Nashi destroyed the ghost trap, sustaining Tamiyo's echo to prevent exploitation.
Valgavoth confronted the survivors as Kaito returned via an artificial Omenpath made by Alquist Proft.
The group escaped through the portal to Ravnica, ending the mission.
events.quote: The group escaped through the portal to Ravnica, ending the mission.

events.summary: Nashi resolved to carry on Tamiyo's storytelling legacy; Tyvar visited Arcavios with Zimone.
events.quote: Nashi resolved to carry on Tamiyo's storytelling legacy

relations.quote: to fulfill his bargain with the demon
The cult was siphoning Tamiyo's stories from her echo to empower Valgavoth
who had entered Duskmourn with Vraska in search of Loot
